title: PI-MLLM: Psychophysics-Inspired Multimodal Large Language Model for Oddly Satisfying Video Emotion Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.28264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Oddly Satisfying Videos (OSVs) can evoke strong viewer responses through repetitive motion, visual tactility, and ASMR-like sounds despite containing few explicit semantic emotion cues. This makes OSVs a challenging setting for Video Emotion Analysis (VEA), since most existing methods focus on semantic video content and under-model the physical sensory dynamics that shape viewer responses. To support Oddly Satisfying Video Emotion Analysis (OSVEA), we construct the Oddly Satisfying Video Dataset (OSVD), comprising 12,000 annotated 5-second clips. Each clip provides viewer-emotion labels under video-only, audio-only, and audio-visual conditions, together with explanations grounded in visual and acoustic sensory evidence. Building on OSVD, we propose PI-MLLM, a psychophysics-inspired multimodal large language model that integrates Modality-Specific Dynamics Alignment (MSDA) and Coalition-Based Audio-Visual Attribution (CAVA). translated_abstract: 解压视频可以通过重复运动、视觉触感和类ASMR的声音唤起观众强烈的情绪反应，尽管其中很少包含明确的语义情绪线索。这使得解压视频成为视频情绪分析（VEA）中的一个具有挑战性的场景，因为大多数现有方法专注于语义视频内容，而对塑造观众反应的物理感官动态建模不足。为了支持解压视频情绪分析（OSVEA），我们构建了解压视频数据集（OSVD），包含12,000个经过标注的5秒视频片段。每个片段在仅视频、仅音频和视听三种条件下均提供了观众情绪标签，并附有基于视觉和听觉感官证据的解释。基于OSVD，我们提出了PI-MLLM，一个受心理物理学启发的多模态大语言模型，它集成了模态特定动态对齐（MSDA）和基于联盟的视听归因（CAVA）。MSDA使用一种
tldr: 本文构建了首个解压视频情绪分析数据集OSVD，并提出了受心理物理学启发的多模态大语言模型PI-MLLM，通过模态特定动态对齐与视听归因机制，分析由物理感官动态而非语义内容驱动的观众情绪。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OSVD, the first dataset for Oddly Satisfying Video Emotion Analysis, and proposes PI-MLLM, a psychophysics-inspired multimodal large language model with Modality-Specific Dynamics Alignment and Coalition-Based Audio-Visual Attribution to analyze viewer emotions driven by physical sensory dynamics rather than semantic content.
